'''Tater tot casserole''' is another easy and tasty casserole.

==Ingredients==
*1–2 [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (0.45–0.91 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]]) [[Cookbook:Beef|ground beef]]
*1 can [[Cookbook:Cream of Mushroom Soup|cream of mushroom soup]] or cream of chicken soup
*½ bag of [[Cookbook:Tater Tots|tater tots]] (approximately)

==Procedure==
#Brown hamburger and drain.
#Mix in cream of mushroom or cream of chicken soup.
#Put mixture in [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]] and cover the top with one layer of tater tots.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at {{convert|350|F}} for 1 hour or until done.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Try adding peas or other vegetables.
* A can of cheddar cheese soup is also a great way to make a meaty, cheesy casserole!
* Shortly before the dish is ready, sprinkle the top with some grated cheddar cheese also.
